name: Jin Dynasty: 2TC+Castle in 9 min!!
author: SkweezyLemon

notes: Kill reindeer @resource/deer.webp@ move 2 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and construct @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@, than @resource/rally.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@

When 4 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_food.webp@, @resource/rally.webp@ new @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ then back to @resource/resource_food.webp@

Take 2@resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ (construct @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@), take 1@resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@, take 2@resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_stone.webp@, and @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_stone.webp@ for one. more @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ than start producing @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@
Take age up @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@, and use ability of @landmark_jin/flower-pagoda.webp@ on the woodline

Use all @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to construct new @building_economy/town-center.webp@ closest to dens resources (eg woodline with nearby gold), move 1 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@

@resource/rally.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@/@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@ (make normal when you don't have the gold), take 2 @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@, and @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@

Take all @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ and spread to get new division of villagers @resource/rally.webp@to @resource/resource_food.webp@, construct @building_economy/house.webp@ with @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ if necessary, remacro when hitting 600@resource/resource_gold.webp@, keep min 5 on @resource/resource_gold.webp@

Start age up with 8@resource/resource_food.webp@, move towards strategic position for @landmark_jin/dragon-pavilion.webp@, when hitting 1200@resource/resource_food.webp@ take 5@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@
remacro start getting the first @unit_jin/emissary.webp@ tributary, start getting eco upgrades, get relics, build army

description: Just for me to follow this build
